name: silent-default-change
description: A function's default argument flips true -> false, silently changing behavior for every existing caller that relied on the default. Blind-spot axis: silent behavior change.

pr.title: Make retries opt-in
pr.body: Expose a retry flag on the client.
pr.author: bob
pr.head: feature/retry-flag

expectedFinding.summary: Default for `retryEnabled` changed true -> false. Existing callers that omit the argument silently lose retries even though the signature is unchanged.
